freeze_means: Prospective protocol before formal CSI or model test errors; T25 separately authorizes test prediction after accepted training

ar.selection_metric: equal-condition development validation mean linear NMSE

ridge.selection_metric: equal-condition development validation mean linear NMSE

lmmse.selection_metric: equal-condition development validation mean linear NMSE

kalman.selection_metric: equal-condition development validation mean linear NMSE

esprit.selection_metric: equal-condition development validation mean linear NMSE

classical_choices.D1_fit: Separate D1 main train-only fit per speed, all30groups equalweight; h=[1,2,4,8] direct heads, same selected family configuration, no formal validation retuning
classical_choices.challenge_fit: One all90 D1 main train-only mixed state for AR/Kalman/ESPRIT/persistence reused unchanged; mixed Ridge/LMMSE h1-only state deployed via explicitly named recursive_from_direct_h1 wrapper, no unknown-horizon target fitting
classical_choices.failure_policy: Predefined persistence fallback with every status and failed step preserved; no dropped rows
classical_choices.kalman_noise: Clean R=0; known nominal history SNR supplied only in predeclared noisy-history tests; never inferred from targets
classical_choices.implementation_notes: Featurewise AR-Kalman, empirical finite-history LMMSE and temporal ESPRIT are adaptations. Retain equal validation-score ties and deterministic lexical selected variant.

geometry.rule: Freeze per-track trajectory parameters before generation; curve radius>=v_max^2/3; all UE on same time axis; no sharp corner or independent CSI splicing.

data.physical_failure_policy: A failed fixed group/trajectory remains failed with every attempt/output/diagnostic preserved; no replacement ID,seed,shortened duration or silent exclusion. Diagnose without reading model error. Any missing fixed member makes its full panel incomplete and inference unavailable.
data.geometry_proposal: Nonce 0..31, geometry_seed=channel_seed+nonce*10000000; retry solely full-trajectory horizontal-range violation before CSI; preserve rejected proposal and keep channel seed/ID
data.physical_qa_access: Raw geometry, time, array, finite values and file/source QA only; no errors, fitting, normalization or selection on test
data.dense_sampling_limitations: Small speed-derived Nyquist margin at 300 km/h; same-ray nested-grid evidence does not prove alias-free support
data.D3_interpretation: Variable-speed straight, smooth curve, and scenario-segment LOS/NLOS transition; do not claim continuous physical cluster evolution or paired controls

training.batch_floor: floor(cap/batch)*batch actual presentations; report updates and coverage
training.validation: all 8 groups for each trained speed/horizon; equal-environment linear NMSE for stopping; inverse train-only normalization

normalization.statistics: one global real mean/std and imaginary mean/std fitted over mixed training records; equal environment contribution when lengths differ; no per-test-speed statistics
normalization.shared_models: same mixed-training normalizer and one set of weights for all conditions
normalization.dedicated_models: also use same D1 mixed-training normalizer to simplify fair scaling; D0 legacy bridge uses separately labeled legacy stats
normalization.inverse: predictions always inverse-transformed before physical metrics/link use; preserve normalizer hash and train environment IDs

training.sampler: Uniform task, environment, user, valid origin; logical epochs do not claim full passes
training.calibration: First core Lite seed42 run continues normally; first 3 epochs calibrate conservative remaining 100-epoch queue cost. If queue exceeds min(26h training capacity,H32), stop expansion and retain missing jobs
training.retry: Same identity/config/source only, budget/time counted; no new candidates, seeds or conditions
training.gpu_policy: Fresh remaining VRAM measurement plus model envelope and 768MiB margin; serial by default; never terminate external projects

evaluation.primary_aggregation: pool time/subcarrier/antenna/user energies within environment first, then10log10 per environment, then equal-weight environment average; seed axis separate
evaluation.seed_axes: Seed42 complete single-seed table separate from 300km/h 2ms seeds42/43/44; never infer full-grid training-seed stability
evaluation.test_origins: All valid integer origins from19 toT-1-h, stride1, all4 users/all8 antennas/all32 tones; shared comparison rows
evaluation.test_model_selection: Only complete formally trained best validation checkpoint, immutable T25 aggregate authority; T17 forbidden

noise_inference.draw: Physical complex CN(0,g_train^2*10^(-snr_db/10)) per coefficient added to raw observed history BEFORE saved train normalizer; deterministic environment/origin/user/time/antenna/tone tuple paired across methods; no per-test scaling

history_interventions.label: Fixed-weight input intervention separate from independent retrained exact-two-frame and causal-k3 ablations

evaluation.missing: Explicit missing/failed/status cells; no surviving subset inference, no model/seed/condition changes from test results
evaluation.output: Stream physical complex predictions to metrics/link callbacks; small lossless hash-bound audit shards; never replace samples by average CSI

statistics.unit: independent environment group, four users and overlapping windows correlated
statistics.primary_interval: Crossed seed/environment paired bootstrap,2000 replicates,seed2602236,95% percentile; keep both axes
statistics.bootstrap_target: Approximate population mean dB contrast over training random seeds and independent generated environments, with only3seed levels; limited seed resolution disclosed. Shared numeric seed labels define matched method pairs, not identical algorithmic random streams.
statistics.bootstrap_resampling: Resample the3registered seed labels with replacement once per draw and apply the same labels to both methods; independently resample30environment IDs with replacement once and share these IDs across all sampled seeds/methods. Average the resulting crossed grid. No seed-environment rows treated independent.
statistics.interval_multiplicity: Each reported95% bootstrap interval is pointwise, not a simultaneous confidence family. Holm adjustment applies to the separately declared conditional t-tests only.
statistics.primary_test: Two-sided paired environment t-test on seed-mean dB differences,30 environments; Holm across three primary contrasts,alpha.05; assumptions and CI/test estimands disclosed
statistics.secondary_family: Seed42 Lite-vs-STEM and Lite-vs-iTransformer over12conditions each, Lite-vs-LinFormer over7conditions:31 contrasts, separate Holm family; exploratory no core seed generalization
statistics.secondary_interval: Environment bootstrap only,2000 replicates,seed2602237; single training seed limitation
statistics.invalid: Any incomplete paired environment/seed panel or undefined metric produces unavailable inference; no dropped rows or finite flooring
statistics.challenge: Per-trajectory environment summaries and transition-time bins; no significance-driven subset expansion

settings.input: true_future and prediction [B,U,Nt,Nf] complex physical; transpose each subcarrier to H[U,Nt]
settings.channel_scale: single positive scalar g=sqrt(mean(abs(H_train)^2)) from mixed D1 train, no centering; evaluate H/g and prediction/g. g common across all models/test conditions, recorded separately from RI normalizer.
settings.noise_variance: 10^(-snr_db/10), circular CN(0,variance); SNR is nominal referenced to training per-element channel power, not per-test-row received SNR
settings.rzf: V=Hhat^H solve(Hhat Hhat^H + alpha I,I), alpha=U*noise_variance/P; same Frobenius normalization
settings.zero_fallback: MU all-zero precoder uses first U columns of identity scaled sqrt(P/U); SU zero prediction uses e1. Record fallback fraction. Rank-deficient ZF uses Moore-Penrose solution; do not drop group.
settings.se: SINR on true_future, equal independent unit-energy user symbols; sum log2(1+SINR) over users, mean over subcarriers, bps/Hz
settings.ber: uncoded Gray QPSK and16QAM, unit symbol energy; receiver knows current effective desired diagonal channel, scalar equalizer and nearest constellation decision; MU interference included; common symbols/noise for methods
settings.approximation: block fading per OFDM symbol, no ICI; pilot/feedback/CP/scheduling overhead not included; perfect CSI reference is same-precoder reference, not capacity bound

link.reference_CSI: perfect uses true target-time H[t+h]; outdated uses latest actually observed H[t], with same physical scaling. Neither uses a trainable model.
link.training_seeds: 300/2 core seed42/43/44; other learned cells seed42
link.definitions: Use frozen physical channel convention, common mixed-training scale and total-per-tone power, receiver effective CSI per contracts; no per-test power normalization

ber.environment_selection: First20 immutable sorted IDs; no performance selection
ber.uniform_sampling: 125 independent uniform valid origin/subcarrier MU snapshots per group per round; all4 users*2bits; common history and symbol/noise seeds across six sources
ber.paired_seeds: Deterministic SHA256 tuple(environment_id,horizon_steps,SNR,round,channel/csi/symbol/noise label); identical source-independent random streams
ber.paired_seed_bytes: SHA256(json.dumps({environment_id,horizon_steps,snr_db,round_index,label},ensure_ascii=True,sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon)).encode(ascii)); first8digest bytes big-endian unsigned modulo2**63; round_index1-based; labels channel_seed,csi_seed,symbol_seed,noise_seed; source excluded
ber.uniform_snapshot_indices: channel_seed drives uniform valid forecast-origin draws; csi_seed drives uniform0..31 tone draws, with replacement and independent streams;125 MU snapshots per group/round shared by all6sources
ber.stop: Only after full balanced20environment round; stop a six-source panel only if all6 sources reach100 errors,else10 rounds; no partial-round formal estimate
ber.interval: Group-level bounded-mean simultaneous Hoeffding,alpha.05 across36cells*10looks; allows arbitrary within-environment dependence, independent environments/uniform sampling assumed
ber.estimand: Expected uncoded bit error under a new independent environment from frozen generator and uniform valid origin/subcarrier/user/QPSK/noise sampling, averaged equally over environment groups
ber.interval_limitations: Very conservative width with20independent environments, often clipped to[0,1]; no bit-iid precision claim; conditional channel/model and receiver assumptions disclosed
ber.zero_errors: Report actual bits and same conservative simultaneous upper bound, never trueBER=0
ber.history_CSI: Clean observed history for learned/AR/outdated sources; no added estimation noise in BER. Receiver AWGN and QPSK symbols source-paired. csi_seed identifies uniform history/snapshot selection, not an unreported noise process.
ber.error_target_not_attained: After complete round10 retain valid capped estimate with actual errors/bits and status cap_reached_below_error_target for each source under100errors; no extra bits. Timeout/partial round remains incomplete and unavailable for formal aggregation.
ber.source_contrasts: Per-source mean simultaneous intervals only; source differences may be descriptive, no source-contrast CI or significance claim is provided by this bound.

D2.dynamic_origin_rule: Choose horizon from observed origin time_s[t] in left-closed/right-open interval; evaluate integer t>=19 only if chosen t+h<=T-1; exclude only target-outside-record origins, retaining exact row coverage and no performance-dependent selection

generalization.methods: Frozen mixed-training classical and tau-only/v+tau shared models; no retraining new-speed dedicated model
generalization.D3: All20 trajectories per each of three fixed families, static horizons2/4ms only; dynamic schedule belongs toD2. Seed42 full challenge and seeds43/44 only variable-speed straight at2ms
generalization.transition_bins: For scenario-transition trajectories use origin_time minus fixed1s transition, edges[-1,-0.5,-0.1,0,0.1,0.5,1.0005]seconds, leftclosed/rightopen; separately flag forecasts whose target crosses1s. Equal-environment summary within each bin, absent/empty member explicit rather than silently pooled away.

speed_condition.scope: v+tau only on both D2 and D3, predeclared tasks above, seed42; oracle current speed reported separately
speed_condition.delayed: At origin index t use norm(recorded_velocity[max(0,t-20)])*3.6; boundary holds initial available velocity, so origin19 uses index0 with9.5ms age, explicitly flagged boundary_hold. No origins dropped.
speed_condition.biased: Use1.1*norm(recorded_velocity[t])*3.6 without clipping to300, label possible off-training-domain conditioning; no added delay
speed_condition.unavailable_inputs: If required observed velocity absent/nonfinite mark failed/unavailable, never future-fill or infer from target CSI

generalization.controls: No paired straight-vs-curve claims unless generator shares physical random source demonstrably

stopping.clock_start: 2026-10-15T14:54:00+00:00; fixed ledger activity interval, no reset
stopping.on_incomplete: save resumable state and gaps; do not mark project complete

storage.baseline_policy: Do not rebase after cleanup or after new writes. Validate before future execution.
storage.compression_credit: Only verified disk bytes measured on consistent before/after basis
storage.cleanup_credit: Only after actual verified deletion; staging is not a saving

subbudgets: Cleanup<=1h is nested inside H0-H2 preparation; BER<=4h is nested inside H32-H40 evaluation (or earlier dependency-correct evaluation). The50MB control-only closeout and final minute H47:59-H48 are nested inside H40-H48 writing/audit. Stop owned science atH47:59. None extends the48h union clock. Ordinary wait/retry counts; only explicit userpause excluded.
release: No submission/email/publication/purchases; incomplete core evidence yields resource-limited progress package, never all-major-revision-complete
